A couple of notes: keep ARR movement tied to specific accounts (we'll need footnotes for any churn/repricing). Marcus — can you take the lead on the workbook consolidation? Laura — please watch recognition timing. Vivek — any high-level guidance I should bake into the narrative?

Thanks — short and focused, please.
